sentences: offset = S1[4:0], width = S1[22:16] (7 bits; S1 bits 23 to 31 are ignored).
When offset + width > 32 the field stops at bit 31: width = min(width, 32 - offset), and `s_bfe_i32` sign-extends from the top bit that exists.
